shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C3 'toast|notif' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -i -C3 'button|toast|flex' | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster; sed -n 120,250p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -i -C4 'button view|view=' | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm/components/Toaster 2>/dev/null; find build -path '*Toaster*' -name '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n -i 'toast' README.md | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat index.d.ts types.d.ts Toaster.d.ts Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts hooks/useToaster.d.ts; cd ../Button && sed -n 1,60p Button.d.ts | rg -n 'view|size|ButtonView|onClick'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Toaster/constants.d.ts; rg -n 'BUTTON_VIEWS|BUTTON_SIZES' -A3 Button/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -rn 'BUTTON_VIEWS' Button/*.d.ts | head; rg -n 'toaster' -i ../../../README.md | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30
